Thanks for taking this on. Attached is RetailCo's standard vendor questionnaire we use to validate capabilities for listing and transactable catalog entries across AWS, Azure and GCP. We need your completed answers by Friday, May 16 so procurement can move the vendor review to legal/commercial.

High-level asks in the form:
- Metering & billing: how you meter usage (per-token / per-minute / SKU) and exported billing records for marketplace ingestion
- Marketplace fulfillment: SKU mapping, transactable listing prerequisites for each cloud marketplace
- Security & compliance evidence: SOC 2, tenant isolation, encryption, logging/audit trails
- Commercial: supported billing terms, refunds, tax handling, and invoicing cadence

Please return the form as PDF or XLSX. If easier, we can schedule a 30-minute sync to walk through the trickier fields (metering model and SKU mapping).

Avery / Lauren — quick notes for the draft:

- Metering: Our runtime can emit both per-token usage (token_count, prompt/response split) and aggregated per-minute compute usage. For marketplace ingestion we typically map our internal SKUs to provider SKUs; we can export a per-SKU CSV that matches AWS/Azure/GCP metering ingestion formats.
- Schema: attaching a minimal metering schema example — includes timestamp, tenant_id, sku_id, units, unit_price_usd, provider_sku (optional). Should satisfy most marketplace ingestion pipelines.
- Security evidence: SOC 2 Type II available (2024 report). We also provide tenant isolation documentation, encryption-at-rest with KMS/HSM options, and audit log exports (per-tenant with retention options).

I dropped a sample schema in the attachments for the questionnaire. I'll fill the metering section in the draft and include a short example export.

Subject: Re: Vendor capability questionnaire for cloud catalog listing — completed response and next steps

Hi Marta — thanks for the form and the time window. Please find our completed questionnaire attached (PDF). Below is a short executive summary of the fields you highlighted.

Executive summary:
- Metering & billing: We support per-token, per-minute, and SKU-based metering. For marketplace ingestion we can provide per-SKU CSV exports that map our internal SKU IDs to provider SKUs, or you can accept invoices from Redwood with a matched reconciliation file.
- Marketplace fulfillment: We support transactable SKUs for AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplaces. For Azure Marketplace there is a required SKU mapping step we can complete with your team; for AWS and GCP we provide a marketplace bridge to push usage records.
- Security & compliance: SOC 2 Type II (2024) available; tenant isolation architecture documented; AES-256 at-rest, TLS1.2+ in transit; KMS/HSM integrations supported for customer-managed keys; audit logs exported per-tenant on request.
- Deployment & data residency: Hosted API (multi-region), Dedicated pools (region pinning), and Private (VPC/on-prem) options. We can restrict data to specific cloud regions for EU or US-only requirements.
- SLA & commercial notes: We provide SLA tiers for Dedicated and Private customers; hosted customers receive standard availability SLOs. Billing cadence is configurable (monthly net-30 standard; channel / marketplace billing depends on the cloud provider terms).

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm whether RetailCo prefers provider-transacted billing (in-cloud marketplace invoices) or vendor-invoiced reconciliation.
2) If you want an Azure transactable SKU, connect us to the Azure ops contact for SKU mapping — we'll prepare the mapping sheet.
3) Proposed follow-up call: Tue May 13, 9:00 AM PT to walk the metering CSV example and the SKU mapping process.

Attachment: RC_Filled_Questionnaire.pdf (completed answers, 12 pages)
